title: Los Angeles FC vs. New York Red Bulls: Decisive MLS Clash
seoTitle: LAFC vs. NY Red Bulls: Decisive MLS Clash
subtitle: Matchday 24 fixture promises excitement between teams looking to bounce back
excerpt: Los Angeles FC hosts the New York Red Bulls this Wednesday, 09/09, at 11:30 PM (Brasília time).
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Los Angeles FC and the New York Red Bulls face each other this Wednesday (09/09) at 11:30 PM at BMO Stadium, in a Matchday 24 fixture of Major League Soccer. The clash is highly anticipated as both teams are going through a period of instability and need a win to boost confidence and improve their position in the standings.

Current form of Los Angeles FC

Los Angeles FC currently sits in sixth place with 37 points from 24 games. Despite being near the top of the standings, the team is winless in its last five matches, recording three draws and two losses. At home, they have seven wins in twelve games, scoring 23 goals and conceding only eleven. D. Bouanga leads the attack with twelve goals, while Son Heung-min has contributed nine assists.

Current form of the New York Red Bulls

The New York Red Bulls are in 23rd place, with 27 points from 23 matches. The club has not recorded a win in its last five games, with three losses and two draws. Away from home, they have won just three of eleven matches, conceding 23 goals and scoring 14. Forward J. Hall stands out with nine goals this season.

Recent head-to-head history

In their last four meetings, Los Angeles FC has two wins, one draw, and one defeat against the New York Red Bulls. Their last duel, in April 2024, ended in a 2-2 draw. Historically, Los Angeles FC holds a slight advantage in the head-to-head record.

Odds and betting

Bookmakers consider Los Angeles FC the favorite, with odds of victory around 1.44. The "both teams to score" bet has odds of 1.53, reflecting Los Angeles FC's offensive potential (38 goals scored) and the defensive vulnerability of the New York Red Bulls (46 goals conceded).

How to watch the match

The clash will be broadcast in Brazil via Apple TV streaming, with no free-to-air TV broadcast scheduled.
